profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as a designer, manufacturer and launcher of advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. Its website is spacex.com.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and trades under the ticker SPCX. Its SEC central index key is 0001181412. Litigation records associated with the company show 111 cases in Texas.

No AI products or MCP servers are recorded for the company, and the material available does not describe AI offerings.
